paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties in Ni45.4Mn39.5In13.1Gd2 alloy with high transformation temperature

evidence.quote: A Heusler Ni 45?4Mn39?5In13?1Gd2 alloy with high transformation temperature has been obtained by substituting 2 at-%Gd for Mn in a ternary Ni 45?4Mn41?5In13?1 ferromagnetic shape memory alloy.
The alloy Ni 45?4Mn39?5In13?1Gd2, with nominal compo- sition, was prepared with high purity elements by melting four times in an arc melting furnace under an argon atmosphere.

The reﬁnement of the grains means the increase in grain boundaries. Because grain boundaries hinder effectively the plastic deformation, the movement of dislocation and the propagation of the cracks, the increase in fracture strength is mainly due to the reﬁnement of the grains.

the improvement of ductility is primarily due to the strengthening effect of the second phase. The interfaces of these two phases with different elastic moduli block the motion of the dislocations, promoting a high increase in compressive stress.
it is speculated that the addition of 2 at-%Gd to the ternary Ni 45?4Mn41?5In13?1 alloy increases the friction losses of phase boundary motion.
